caption: The drawing depicts an elongated, horizontal decorative element with a scrolling, foliate design. This element starts from the left side with a detailed and colored section rendered in shades of black, grey, and gold, featuring intricate curling leaves and vine motifs. The design transitions to the right, gradually fading into a pale, unfinished pencil sketch of the same scrolling pattern. The rightmost part consists only of light grey outlines, without any applied color or shading. The background is a plain, unadorned off-white or beige surface, with no additional objects or markings.
title: Stern Piece from "Henrietta Francis"
